verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair axis for a robotics fleet platform, but the evidence pack never documents a Formant command-line tool. It shows only Python Cloud and Agent SDKs, APIs, a Docker installer and agent environment variables, which are building blocks or adjacent features rather than an official CLI. The port-forwarding FAQ describes forwarding a device page to localhost but does not name or document a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
